caption:
You already feel this if you've ever called a leaky faucet back before a full roof replacement.

Not every lead is worth the same five minutes. But if follow-up runs out of a shared inbox or a group text, every new contact looks identical the moment it lands.

The Black Arrow platform scores each lead the second it comes in, so the highest-value opportunities surface first instead of getting buried under low-value calls.

Every lead still gets an instant text-back. The scoring just tells your team where to spend the next five minutes.
